en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘We mentioned the plucking from the moustache, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is a good display, and it is from the Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Once we mentioned trimming the mustache before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is a charm and trimming it is of Sunnah.”’
